fee.value: Earlham's current cost page says students can apply for free. This verifies that the college application itself has no fee; FAFSA, English testing, credential evaluation, visa, travel, housing and enrollment costs are separate.

evidence.quote: Not sure if you can afford Earlham? Apply for free and find out!

fee.value: Gettysburg's current admissions FAQ lists a $60 application fee. Qualified applicants may request a fee waiver through their admissions counselor. International applicants follow the same Common Application process, with additional international documents where applicable.

evidence.quote: The application fee is $60; fee waivers are available to qualified students
